Preserve the frozen sequencing map: verified-hit counting BEFORE the nil-payload check; nil SourceContent warns and bypasses lookup+publication while pointer-to-empty stays cacheable; publish requires live cache/store + nonempty computed key with artifacts before manifest authorization; guard clauses inside helpers; current Result on each early return; no new deferred child-span endings or error wrapping. No parser/type/lowering/cache-schema/Sonar-setting edits.

features.description: Design Phase 3 (prove preservation and analyze, ~4h). Run the design's ten named mutation probes, EACH in its own isolated disposable execution worktree (a filesystem copy of the tree under .snap/M3/mutations/, one directory per probe named after its mutation ID, e.g. .snap/M3/mutations/MUT-SOURCE-EMPTY/; the design's Non-Goals confine mutation probing to that disposable tree -- the tracked tree is never mutated), banking each required failing oracle plus the restored-green result; a surviving mutation requires strengthening the corresponding observable assertion before preservation is declared (a compile error or unrelated environment failure is not a kill). Then run the focused packages under -race, the repository aggregate gates (make test / make lint / make ci) as landing evidence, and the final five-file gocognit report. Exact-revision Sonar re-analysis (first-party /api/issues/search scoped by project + analysis branch/PR + go:S3776, pinning the analysis commit SHA, with positive component controls and all five old->new function mappings) and PR-level evidence are CONTROLLER-verified steps outside the executor's gates; if Sonar is unavailable the exact-function criterion remains pending and is reported to the controller.
